name: Prince Marion
source:
The protagonist of this story and the prince of Gatria.
He's basically an idiot. An innocent and spoiled prince who was spoiled by his father.
Its values ​​are insane, extremely self-centered, and only thinks of people as objects.
He's a crazy thinker who makes everything he eats for the sake of his curiosity.

His hobby is "looking at animals in the forest".
He collects rare and rare beasts from the continent, and his favorite is the monsters that breed on humans.
